title: Hood County: How many students were enrolled in Granbury High School in 2023-24 school year?
text:
Texas State Board Of Education Secretary Pat Hardy (2024) | twitter.com/pathardy
Texas State Board Of Education Secretary Pat Hardy (2024) | twitter.com/pathardy
according to the Texas Education Agency.
Of all the students welcomed in the 2023-24 school year, 52.7% of them were boys, and 47.3% were girls.
Data also showed that the majority of students identified themselves as white, representing 67.2% of the total enrollment in Granbury High School.
Among the 17 schools in Hood County, Acton Middle School ranked second in enrollment numbers with 917 students, while John and Lynn Brawner Elementary School welcomed 890 students and ranked third in the 2023-24 school year.
Granbury High School is a part of Granbury ISD, which roughly covers schools within Hood County with its main office in Granbury.
In the previous school year, Granbury High School also had the highest number of students among Hood County schools.
A recent study by WalletHub classified Texas as one of the least-educated states in the U.S., ranking it 41st out of 50 in educational quality and student outcomes.
Underfunding is a frequently cited challenge facing the state's school districts. According to a 2024 report from the Texas Education Agency, per-pupil funding has not increased since 2019, despite inflation rates rising by more than 20% since then.
“As a result, many districts in our very own Central Texas region are being forced to cut back on essential programs, services, consider school closures, and adopt deficit budgets just to provide students with the education that they deserve,” Hutto ISD Trustee James Matlock stated in an interview.
